about: Glass Studio's clip library: actions that came out well on the glass, in packs. Each action becomes a clip in a look; its name follows the clip roles in tools/clip_roles.py (kind 'moment' becomes idle_<key> in her main pose, relaxed_<key> in a relaxed one, full_<key> in full body). Actions marked hands use a hand: if her pose holds something (a heart, crossed arms), say how she frees the hand and puts it back. Don't name effects you don't want, and no breathing words (see prompts.py).

packs.title: Essentials
packs.about: What every look needs before the glass can use it: a calm loop she can talk over (lip sync), listening, thinking.

packs.title: Quiet moments
packs.about: The shuffled deck she plays while nobody talks. Each five-second clip adds about five seconds before anything repeats; 40 clips is a bit over three minutes.

packs.title: Expressions
packs.about: Played once when what was said feels that way.

packs.title: Oops
packs.about: Her face at her own mishap (a tool failed, a picture didn't come out): rueful, not sad.

packs.title: Sleep
packs.about: Dozing off, sleeping and waking (11 pm to 7 am after ten quiet minutes), and yawns near bedtime. Needs an asleep picture.

packs.title: Selfie moves
packs.about: Look-at-me moves, played with a picture she just made of herself.

packs.title: Full body
packs.about: Her whole figure, from a full-body picture; the glass cuts to one now and then, and to a twirl for a selfie.

packs.title: Picture looks
packs.about: Turning to a picture floating beside her face, or glancing down at one lower right.

packs.title: Pose changes
packs.about: Moving between her main and relaxed pictures (Aloy lowering and raising her hand). Needs both pictures.

actions.text: Her eyelids grow heavy; she gives a small soft yawn, her eyes slowly close and her head tips gently down and to one side as she drifts off to sleep.
She is asleep: her eyes are closed and her face is peaceful, with only the faintest movement now and then.
Asleep, she stirs slightly and a tiny contented smile crosses her face, then she settles back, her eyes closed.

actions.ending: She stays in the same place.
